prompts.register:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: a full-bleed watercolor BACKGROUND IMAGE for a small welcome-screen action tile in the RazemGo camping travel app. Create artwork only, never an app screenshot or UI mockup. A gently horizontal 4:3 composition, fully painted edge to edge with an OPAQUE background.
Input roles: Image 1 is the original transparent illustration to recompose into a complete campsite scene. Retain its subject and recognizable character. Image 2 is a reference ONLY for the app's existing full-background watercolor landscapes: fine paper grain, translucent watercolor pigments, sage and pine greens, pale blue mountain ridges, warm cream daylight, natural painterly detail.
Primary change: replace every transparent or blank outer area of Image 1 with a coherent hand-painted campsite environment, painted seamlessly behind and around the main subject. Widen the framing slightly as needed. This must be a real complete landscape illustration, not the original sticker dropped onto a flat color.
Composition constraints: this asset will fill a small tile around 165 by 144 logical pixels, with a rounded caption added later in the BOTTOM 25%. Keep the important subject centered in the upper and middle portions, within x=20%-80% and y=10%-73%, with sufficient margin for a centered mobile cover crop. Keep faces and the characteristic parts of the vehicle above y=65%. Make the scene clear at a small size. Use calm low-detail grass along the lower edge where our caption will sit; no baked-in caption or gradient.
Keep the existing illustrated camping aesthetic. No photography, glossy 3D, plastic cartoon, vector-art look, detached cutout edges, blank white margins, transparency, text, letters, logos, watermarks, frames, badges, icons, buttons or UI.
Specific scene: exactly TWO friendly adult travelers, the same man and woman from Image 1, smiling and giving each other a natural high-five beside a cream and muted-teal camping CARAVAN TRAILER. Preserve their general sage, cream and blue clothing, daypacks and welcoming mood. The trailer sits slightly behind them, with a simple warm mustard awning and a little camping furniture. Bring their upper bodies and high-five into the central upper part of the painting, readable and with natural anatomy. A grassy clearing, a few pines at the edges, blue distant hills, gentle sky and fresh warm sunlight fill the entire background. No extra people, children, campfire or other vehicles. The feeling is joining a welcoming community.
